prose.name: Recovery: Missing Payroll on <Planet>
prose.briefing: The crew at the <Place> haven't been paid this week. The courier carrying their payroll ledger never arrived. Find where it stopped.
prose._rewrite: Jessica 2026-10-19, his 'the 03a writing feels weak': it named nothing (a load, it, the rest, what was taken). Now the load is the crew's pay: site-agnostic, somebody waiting, and the two halves make sense (ledger by courier, pay ahead to the site locker).

beats.objective: Find the courier's crate at the <SecondPlace>
beats.journal: I found the courier's crate at the <SecondPlace> with the payroll ledger still in it. The pay went ahead to the site's locker, so I need to take the ledger there.
beats._item: Jessica 2026-10-19: a noun that is safe at any site, which the old 'Signed-Out Consignment (1 of 2)' was guarding against.
say: That's the ledger. Take it to the site. The pay went ahead to their locker, so once it's signed for, we're done.

beats._place: His playtest 2026-10-13: 'Don't like the pushing back away from site thing. Let's switch that to just using a med marker at a different POI.' The crate waits at a second POI; approach.lose is gone.

beats.objective: Sign for the pay at the <Place>
beats.journal: The pay locker at the <Place> has been forced and emptied. I need to find whoever took the pay, and they can't have gone far.
say: The locker's been forced. The ledger's here. The pay isn't. Somebody knew it was coming. Go and get it back.
beats.name: Pay Locker
beats._at: 2026-10-27, his: 'The delivery box is just sitting in a random place, make it a better marker'. Was RECenterLocRef (the middle of the site, often open ground). Now REContainerLocRef with replace: the site's OWN loot spot, placed by its designer against a wall or a building, and the site's box is disabled so the forced locker stands where the site already keeps things. Pool unchanged (150). Unproven until his play: the lint counts 146 of 380 refs carrying it as containers (replace covers those).

beats.journal: I took the crew's pay back from the people who forced the locker. Now I need to put it in the locker and sign the ledger.
beats._item: Jessica 2026-10-19: a noun that is safe at any site, which the old 'Signed-Out Consignment (1 of 2)' was guarding against.
say: That's the pay. Put it in the locker and sign the ledger, and I'll close the docket.

beats.journal: A crew at the <Place> hadn't been paid. I found the courier's ledger, took their pay back from whoever forced the locker, and signed for it.
